sources.excerpt: Edition (Color): Olive Drab (English) Black Ruined (LTD) Olive Drab White Glow-in-the-Dark LTD Buy Now The first Sputnik returns! Featuring the original v1 circuit, with a twist - the Sputnik I is powered by NOS silicon transistors, which take this Sputnik to a whole new level. NO COMPROMISE Bringing the Sputnik circuit back to a compact enclosure for the first time since 2013, Sputnik I also introduces silicon transistors to the Sputnik line. Sputnik I delivers all the texture, warmth, and mojo of the original while adding the benefits of rock-solid stability and consistency. Free from the quirks of germanium: noise, temperature sensitivity, and fragility - Sputnik I: Silicon Fuzz arrives as the most dependable and streamlined version of the circuit to date. SMALLER FOOTPRINT, BIGGER SOUND The silicon transistors bring their own sonic edge, offering additonal gain levels to go further than any Sputnik to date. We’ve also included the updated Scan control from the Sputnik IIb , expanding your tonal shaping options while preserving the untamed spirit of Drift Mode . In keeping with the original , the Sputnik I has no input transformer, making it more lively, while providing a wider frequency range. It’s the Sputnik III ’s wild younger sibling, with a sound and feel that’s an absolute joy to play. Sputnik I delivers remarkable tonal versatility. The Range control spans everything from light overdrive to thick, sustained fuzz, while the unique Calibrate control shapes your tone in dynamic interaction with it — unlocking an even broader spectrum of sounds. And that’s only scratching the surface of what the Sputnik I can do. Alongside the three main control knobs, Sputnik I features two toggle switches: Filter and Sync/Drift . The Filter switch engages a second tone circuit, instantly doubling your tonal palette. Switch to Drift Mode , and Sputnik transforms - unleashing synth-like tones, oscillation, pseudo-octaves, 8-bit artifacts, and more. The mini Scan control adds another layer of precision, making every parameter highly interactive in Drift Mode, including your instrument’s own controls. Go subtle or go extreme - you can shape it, tame it, or let it run wild. Sputnik I delivers an uncommonly wide orbit of fuzz tones; from smooth and vintage to splatty, sputtery, and completely off-the-rails. Exceptionally responsive and versatile, the Sputnik I: Silicon Fuzz is ready to propel you into new sonic galaxies, where soaring sustain, rich textures, and cosmic levels of chaos await. SPUTNIK I FEATURES Unique original fuzz circuit, powered by NOS silicon transistors Sputnik returns to small format for the first time since 2013 DRIFT Mode offers wild oscillation, octave and 8-bit artifact tones FILTER switch provides two voicing options for the CALIBRATION tone control True-Bypass switching via soft-click footswitch Discrete, analog circuit using only through-hole components Completely soldered and wired by hand in Portland, Oregon Can be powered 9v battery or external power supply Four signed and numbered First Editions: Olive Drab, White, Black, and Blue Ultra-limited Blue Edition is only available through Spaceman Dealers Limited-batch Olive Drab Edition features Cyrillic engraved faceplate, Custom knobs, and smooth glass indicator jewel TRULY HANDCRAFTED As part of the PDX Custom Series, the Sputnik I is fully soldered and wired by hand in Portland, Oregon. On top of the cast-aluminum enclosure sits an indestructible engraved vinyl faceplate and large indicator jewel, with a hand-hammered number badge riveted to the back. This pedal is built to last a lifetime, both on Earth or in the vacuum of space and carries a Limited Lifetime Warranty to prove it. sources.excerpt: Published on October 12, 2025 Spaceman Effects fuzz pedal Glow-In-The-Dark Glow-In-The-Dark Glow-In-The-Dark Glow-In-The-Dark Limited Edition Limited Edition Limited Edition Limited Edition Information The Spaceman Effects Sputnik I: Silicon Fuzz marks the return of the original Sputnik circuit in a more compact format, featuring a new silicon transistor design that enhances performance while preserving the signature tonal character of the series. Retaining the hallmark texture, warmth, and dynamic response of the original germanium version, this updated model substitutes NOS silicon transistors for improved reliability, consistency, and increased gain potential. Developed as part of Spaceman's PDX Custom Series , the Sputnik I is hand-built in Portland, Oregon, using discrete, through-hole analog components. The silicon transistors eliminate the temperature sensitivity and fragility associated with germanium while providing a tighter, more stable low end and a slightly more aggressive edge. The result is a fuzz capable of delivering both refined vintage smoothness and chaotic, sputtery destruction. The control layout provides deep interactivity between parameters. The Range control sets the fuzz intensity, from light overdrive textures to full saturation. Calibrate adjusts the tone contour, dynamically shaping midrange response in conjunction with Range. Scan , borrowed and refined from the Sputnik IIb, manipulates internal biasing to introduce unpredictable harmonic textures and overtones, particularly when paired with the Drift mode. In Drift mode, the circuit becomes unstable by design, producing oscillation, pseudo-octaves, 8-bit artifacts, and synth-like modulation that react to playing dynamics and instrument volume. The Filter toggle introduces a secondary tone circuit that cuts bass and scoops mids, offering an alternate voice for the Calibrate control. The combination of these modes makes the Sputnik I highly expressive, capable of moving between articulate fuzz tones and experimental, noise-based effects. With its silicon topology, the pedal offers higher headroom, improved stability, and a wider frequency range than previous iterations. The absence of an input transformer, as in the original Sputnik I, contributes to a more immediate and lively response. Power can be supplied via a standard 9V battery or external adapter, and the pedal employs soft-click true-bypass switching for seamless integration into any signal chain. Sputnik I is available in several limited editions: Olive Drab, White, and Black finishes through Spaceman's webstore, and a Blue Edition exclusive to authorized dealers. The Olive Drab version includes unique custom knobs, a Cyrillic-engraved faceplate, and a smooth glass indicator jewel. Each pedal features a cast aluminum enclosure with an engraved vinyl faceplate, a hand-hammered serial badge, and carries Spaceman's limited lifetime warranty. Controls Level : Sets the output volume. Range : Adjusts fuzz gain from mild drive to full saturation. Calibrate : Shapes tonal character and midrange response in tandem with Range. Scan : Alters internal bias and harmonic behavior, especially effective in Drift mode. Filter (Toggle) : Engages secondary tone circuit with bass cut and mid scoop. Sync/Drift (Toggle) : Switches between stable Sync mode and unstable Drift mode for oscillating or synth-like effects. Footswitch : Activates or bypasses the effect; true-bypass operation. Technical Specifications Circuit Type: Discrete analog fuzz using NOS silicon transistors Power: 9V DC center-negative or 9V battery Switching: True bypass via soft-click footswitch Construction: Hand-soldered, through-hole components Enclosure: Cast aluminum with engraved vinyl faceplate Production: Hand-built and wired in Portland, Oregon Editions: Olive Drab (limited), White, Black, and dealer-exclusive Blue Price: $299 USD Highlights Original Sputnik circuit reimagined with NOS silicon transistors Enhanced gain range, stability, and tonal consistency Expanded control set including updated Scan and Drift modes Dual voicing via Filter toggle for additional tonal flexibility Wide spectrum from smooth sustain to chaotic oscillation Compact footprint with handcrafted Portland construction Available in multiple limited-edition finishes with serialized plates Includes Spaceman's limited lifetime warranty Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2025-10-08 Spiral Caster NEW!
